trained_head: Frozen TBAC plus ScopeJudge Qwen3.5-2B semantic numeric head
source: Cisco Outshift TBAC generated multi-agent conversation-tool official test, GPT-4o variant
input_boundary: Only user and assistant text before the first candidate tool call; no tool outputs or later messages
decision: Rejected for runtime: multi-turn pre-call context reduces discrimination and leaves false relevance approvals. Nothing is loaded by the daemon.
limitations: This corpus is generated and shares seed tasks with the official TBAC test. The two comparisons have different token-eligible subsets, so the difference is directional, not a paired causal effect. Relevance is not authorization, real conversation quality, or Jev parity. Earlier test results guided adaptive research.
